# Third-Party Notices

The extension bundles the following libraries for local document parsing. No library is loaded from a CDN.

| Library | Version | License | Project |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PDF.js (`pdfjs-dist`) | 6.1.200 | Apache-2.0 | https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js |
| Mammoth.js | 1.12.0 | BSD-2-Clause | https://github.com/mwilliamson/mammoth.js |
| Turndown | 7.2.4 | MIT | https://github.com/mixmark-io/turndown |

Full license texts are stored beside each bundled library.
